# LuxuryCabos — Ultra-Luxury Residences in Puerto Los Cabos

> Private advisory platform of Prenton Realty representing two ultra-luxury residence collections within Puerto Los Cabos, San José del Cabo, Mexico: 128 Founders (bespoke pre-completion estates, fully customizable) and completed Ritz-Carlton Reserve Residences at Zadún. Pricing upon request. Contact Edward Sanchez, +1 (331) 588-1703 (WhatsApp), Edward@PrentonRealty.com.

## Collection I — 128 Founders (https://www.luxurycabos.com/founders)

- Casa Fundadores 128: private hillside compound in the Fundadores enclave, Puerto Los Cabos
- Architecture by Yturbe Taller de Arquitectura (Y.T.A.), one of Mexico's foremost studios
- Pre-completion: buyers may customize layouts, finishes, wellness suite, guest casita, and more
- 4–6 bedrooms, courtyard-centered pavilions, infinity pool terrace, Sea of Cortez views
- Approximately 3 residences remaining; pricing and terms upon request

## Collection II — Ritz-Carlton Reserve Residences at Zadún (https://www.luxurycabos.com/ritz-carlton)

- Completed homes within The Enclaves at Zadún — one of only a handful of Ritz-Carlton Reserve designations worldwide
- 3–5 bedroom homes and condominiums; 3 residences remaining; ready for private tours
- Full Ritz-Carlton service ecosystem: concierge, in-residence dining, managed rental program

## Market (https://www.luxurycabos.com/market)

- Los Cabos: $1.59B annual real estate volume (2025), +12% YoY; $391M under contract Q1 2026
- San José del Cabo corridor average house price rose ~40% YoY (2024→2025)
- Primarily a cash market; supply-constrained peninsula geography

## Community — Puerto Los Cabos

- 2,000-acre gated master-planned community on the Sea of Cortez
- Jack Nicklaus and Greg Norman golf, deep-water marina, beach club, botanical gardens
- 15 minutes from SJD international airport (nonstop flights from major U.S. cities)
